app.name: Dile
tray.tooltip.recording: Dile — recording, let go when you are done
tray.tooltip.preparing: Dile — getting the speech engine ready
tray.tooltip.nomodel: Dile — no speech model, so nothing can be written yet
tray.tooltip.enginefailed: Dile — the speech engine will not start
dialog.model.title: Download the speech model?
dialog.model.body: Dile needs a speech model before it can write anything down. It downloads {model} — {size} — from huggingface.co, once. What you say is transcribed on this machine and never leaves it.
settings.title: Dile settings
settings.group.dictionary: Dictionary — it also becomes the engine's prompt
settings.hotkey.hint: Hold one modifier key on its own — the right Ctrl ships as the default, because a hand can rest on it for a whole sentence — or press a chord such as Ctrl+Alt+Space. A lone modifier never swallows anything, so Right Ctrl + C still copies; Ctrl+Space is excluded permanently — the input method swallows it.
settings.cleanup.autotransfer.hint: The panel transfers the result by itself after this long. Pressing ✗ or editing the text stops it.
settings.engine.state.crashed: the engine went down and is being restarted
settings.dictionary.none: No terms yet. A term added here is spelled your way in the transcript, and is given to the engine before it listens.
settings.dictionary.variants.placeholder: what the engine writes instead, separated by commas
settings.general.autostart.note: Start in the tray when Windows starts
settings.error.save: The settings could not be written to disk.
settings.error.devices: The microphones could not be listed.
settings.error.models: The model folder could not be opened.
settings.error.chord.excluded: Ctrl+Space cannot be used: the input method swallows it before Dile ever sees it.
settings.error.chord.nomodifier: A hotkey needs at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win.
settings.error.chord.unreadable: That key cannot be used as a trigger.
settings.error.dictionary.duplicate: That term is already in the list.
panel.state.recording.hint: Let go to stop · Esc cancels
panel.state.noengine: The speech engine will not start
panel.state.gone: The window this was meant for is gone
panel.hint.engine: Open the settings and look at Engine
panel.hint.gone: Copy the text, or press Esc to let it go
